prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No clear effect has been seen for any kind of change tested so far, as no individual test yielded a significant win.
No clear effect was seen for adoption redesigns or choose_path copy changes across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for finish notifications, finish new screens, home notifications, home wait info, sign-in copy, and sign-in reordering, as only one test has been conducted per category.
Predictions were systematically too high across Round 1 tests compared to measured outcomes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -0.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: +2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Preset Pet Quick Choice Flow: Redesign the choose path screen into a split layout with clear visual cards comparing instant starter pets against custom pet creation. (why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate and high mean completion time (514s); clear interactive split cards reduce decision friction.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Pre-Sign-In Account Recovery Note: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen explaining how signing into an existing account restores saved desktop pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Placement Preview Screen: Insert a new interactive desktop simulator screen right before home intro to demonstrate where the pet lives on the desktop. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and support received 3 complaints about pets not displaying on the desktop.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Personality Quiz Flow: Add a short quiz screen before pet selection to help guide hesitant users toward their ideal pet match. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a long median duration of 89s, indicating indecision during selection.)
4: [finish, layout] Desktop Controls Spotlight Layout: Re-layout home intro with a spotlight design highlighting shortcut controls for hiding, dragging, and interacting with the desktop pet. (why: Support received 3 emails asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
5: [home, redesign] Interactive Story Scroll Waiting Room: Redesign the waiting screen into a story scroll layout featuring pet trick demonstrations while background assets finalize. (why: The waiting screen has a high median duration (201s) and mean duration (2336s), causing drop-off.)
6: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Sign-In Move: Move sign-in after adoption certificate step so users complete pet adoption before creating or verifying an account. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% early on; deferring sign-in until after adoption builds investment first.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable system readiness notification alert switch on the waiting screen to inform users when background setup finishes. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not appearing or app failing to launch during long setup waits.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Full Bleed Onboarding Story Kickoff: Switch the introductory story screen to full_bleed layout to establish app value before path selection. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path before initiating pet adoption.)

scores.note: Choose_path redesigns showed negative results in prior tests (-0.7%), high implementation cost.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in copy changes showed +2.1% lift previously.
Adding a new screen to finish step previously yielded -0.1% lift and increases friction.
Adoption step has high dropoff, but adoption redesigns failed (-0.9%) and adding quiz screens adds friction.
Addresses 3 support tickets with a layout update at moderate cost.
Home wait info changes previously lost conversion (-1.9%), and full screen redesign is high cost.
Sign-in reordering previously had a mild positive outcome (+0.4%).
Low cost config change; home notifications showed +2.5% in prior test and addresses 3 support mails.
Choose_path changes have consistently shown no positive effect across tests.
